Amazing Food
May 2026 • Solo
If you’re in Da Nang and even thinking about where to eat—just go to Pause And Enjoy. Seriously.

Everything about this place lives up to the name. The vibe is relaxed, the service is warm without being overbearing, and the food? Absolutely unforgettable.

I ordered the pho, fresh rice paper rolls, and a pineapple juice—and wow. The pho was rich, deeply flavorful, and comforting in that way only a perfectly balanced broth can be. You can tell it’s been simmered with care, not rushed. The rice paper rolls were incredibly fresh, light, and packed with texture—each bite felt clean and satisfying. And the pineapple juice? Bright, naturally sweet, and the perfect refreshing pairing to everything else.

Nothing felt heavy, nothing felt rushed—just really thoughtful, delicious food done right.

It’s the kind of place where you sit down for a meal and end up staying longer than you planned, just soaking it all in.

10/10 would come back without hesitation.
